shape: someone who lives far away now, and the one small habit you both kept

slides.text: you live three hundred miles away now, but we both still leave the kitchen window open an inch, [[even in december]].

caption:
some habits stick long after you leave the small house she built.
my grandma still steps outside to check the morning air before putting the kettle on, and so do i.
send this to the person whose quiet daily habits live in your kitchen now.

#grandma #grandparents #grandmashouse
alt: A text slide about keeping a shared daily habit across a long distance, with a small green donkey shading its eyes to look far away.
